title: Launch video props
description: What the Marketer emits for the launch video. Props JSON only — never TSX, never any executable code authored by a model (FR-026, DESIGN.md 6.4). The `content` / `style` split is load-bearing: the grounding check runs over `content` and nothing else, so an on-screen price cannot be placed somewhere the checker does not look (research.md R5). The vertical cut is the same archetype at 1080x1920 consuming these same props.

archetype_id.description: Selected by the Strategist in the brand doc; the Marketer does not choose it.

content.description: EVERYTHING that appears on screen as text or as a value. Every leaf here is set-differenced against runs.grounding_set before render (FR-022, FR-026).

values.description: On-screen numeric values, e.g. a price row. Structured so the checker reads them as values rather than parsing them out of a rendered frame.

style.description: Presentation only. NOT grounding-checked, and therefore MUST NOT be able to carry a value that appears to the viewer as a fact. Every field here is copied from the brand doc or is a bounded render setting.
